module: Node "Get Powertrain Data" (category `once_f_duration`). Requests a property of a powertrain device (`core_vehicleBridge.requestValue(veh, cb, 'powertrainDevice', device, property)`). Input pins: `vehId`, `device` (device name), `property`; output `value` (any). Duration state: inactive/started/finished.
notes: The request callback contains `dump(val) dumpz(self, 1)`: debug traces are written to the log on each response.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

init.desc: Node constructor, called at its creation by the flowgraph editor/manager; initializes the internal state.

onNodeReset.desc: Clears the received response and goes to `inactive` duration.

work.desc: When the response has arrived, copies it to `value` and goes to `finished`.

workOnce.desc: Sends the powertrain request to the vehicle and goes to `started`.
